description: [read-only] Finds flayr tools that are not in this list (ads, studio, campaigns, stores, …). Returns name, one-line purpose and toolset. Then call the tool by name, or load its toolset with enable_toolset to get its full schema.

query.description: Words describing the task, e.g. "boost a post" or "posting queue".

toolset.description: Only search this toolset, e.g. "ads". One of: core, publishing, campaigns, analytics, studio, ads, stores, ops.

name: search_tools
title: Search flayr tools
